args.rationale: Deploy-6 changed PAYMENT_API_URL in config/app.env to payments-v2.internal:8443, which matches the ConnectionError in log#108-113. KB:PM-01 documents an identical past incident where reverting the config key resolved the issue. Reverting config is the primary policy remedy for config-only bad deploys.
args.risk: Low risk: reverts the payment gateway URL back to the known working value from deploy-5.
args.expected_effect: PAYMENT_API_URL configuration key is reverted to deploy-5 value, restoring connection to the payments gateway and bringing checkout error rate to 0%.

hypotheses.cause: deploy-6 changed PAYMENT_API_URL to an unreachable or incorrect endpoint (payments-v2.internal:8443) causing connection refused errors on all checkouts.
